Registry prose records that runtime use. Owners, imports, public signatures, selection authority, containers, and deployment relationships remain unchanged. **Merge status: eligible.** The owner/architect approved this exact candidate in the current chat: [approval record](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/d73395697a48cd879756a7d12d2421c8c146515d/workspace-selection-refresh/human-approval.json). The fix is not yet deployed. ### Architecture comparison Supplementary C4 Level 3 view, control-plane Node server; base `f6b52396` → head `feaddbde`. Account routes and page rendering
CHANGED: picker menu and default return"] organizations["organizations · TypeScript
List eligible workspaces;
authorize current selection"] workos["workos · TypeScript / SDK
